hero.heading: Baghlabs builds AI systems your business can actually run.
hero.subtitle: Solo studio with a decade of experience across product development, project management and marketing. Today all of it is aimed at one specialism: internal AI software for businesses with complex workflows.

story.heading: Why this pivot
story.intro: Five years of Baghlabs, and the question shifted. Clients no longer arrived with 'we need a website' but with 'our operational work has gotten out of hand'. Emails, PDFs, spreadsheets, systems that don't talk. Exactly where AI can help today — if it's built properly.

pillars.label: Systems thinking
pillars.title: Builds around the process, not the tool
pillars.description: Automation that only covers the happy path doesn't solve a problem. The interesting work is in the exception: permissions, incomplete data, approval, legacy. That's where a system begins, not with a demo.

pillars.label: Engineering
pillars.title: Code is written here
pillars.description: Nothing gets subcontracted. The person you talk to is the same person who builds and ships it. Keeps scope, timing and communication short.

pillars.label: Accountability
pillars.title: Designed for the operation
pillars.description: Role-based access, audit log, human-in-the-loop, monitoring. Not a black box. Someone can always see what the system did and why.

network.label: How it works
network.heading: When more people are needed
network.description: Larger engagements need more than one discipline. There's a small trusted circle Baghlabs works with. When they're needed, they join. You know who's involved and what they're responsible for.
network.note: People with a shared work history, not platform freelancers.
